user.title: Family Link
user.description:
Family Link has no official API: the integration uses your Google session, like the familylink.google.com web app.

1. On a computer, sign in to {url} with your **parent** account.
2. Export the cookies of that page, for instance with the Cookie-Editor extension (Export → JSON), or copy the `Cookie` request header from the browser's developer tools (Network tab, any request to kidsmanagement-pa.clients6.google.com).
3. Paste them below.

The cookies stay in Home Assistant; the integration keeps them fresh by itself.

data_description.cookies: JSON export, cookies.txt or Cookie header. It must hold SAPISID (or __Secure-3PAPISID).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Google no longer accepts the session of {account}. Sign in to {url} again, export the cookies and paste them below.

error.invalid_cookies: No Google session cookie found: the text must contain SAPISID or __Secure-3PAPISID.
error.invalid_auth: Google refused these cookies. Sign in to familylink.google.com again and export them once more.
error.cannot_connect: Family Link could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.no_children: This account supervises no child in Family Link.

abort.already_configured: This Google account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: These cookies belong to another Google account.
